actionMetadataOverrides.name: messages.messages.get
actionMetadataOverrides.reason: Issue #30: Joomla 6.1 administrator/components/com_messages/src/Model/MessageModel.php::getItem marks the stored message read after loading it. Describe this native effect without changing the public read interface; internal write planning uses a separately declared recipient-scoped native-owned-record snapshot.

metadata.description: Gets one private message by numeric identifier through Joomla's native API. The native item GET marks the stored message read and may return the representation loaded before that change. Eligible local, uncustomized write planning uses a separately declared recipient-scoped native-owned-record snapshot without marking the message read.
